title: Correct thickness difference
description: Essential: The final answer must be λ/2.

title: Constructive interference condition
description: Important: The response must apply the correct condition for constructive interference in thin films with a phase shift (e.g., 2d + λ/2 = mλ).

title: Adjacent fringe order relation
description: Important: The reasoning must relate the conditions for two adjacent bright fringes (orders m and m+1).

title: Algebraic manipulation
description: Optional: The solution shows clear steps of subtracting equations to isolate the thickness difference Δd.

title: Unit consistency
description: Optional: The answer is expressed with the correct unit (length, consistent with λ).

title: Missing phase shift
description: Pitfall: Applying the wrong interference condition (e.g., 2d = mλ) without accounting for the π phase shift.

title: Order confusion
description: Pitfall: Misidentifying adjacent fringes (e.g., using m and m+2) leading to an incorrect multiple of λ/2.
